Check for salt, add jaggery and the methi muthias and lightly mix. Cover and let it cook on low flame for 3-4 minutes
Garnish with cilantro and serve

recipes.name: Upma

ingredients.prep_notes: or Cream of Rice for GF

steps: Bring water to a boil in a separate pot.
Heat 1 1/2 tbsp ghee and saute chana dal for 1 minute.
Add urad dal and saute another minute.
Add fenugreek and mustard seeds; when mustard pops, add cumin and asafoetida and saute 1 minute.
Add green chilies, ginger, curry leaves, onion, and salt; saute until onion is translucent.
Add Cream of Wheat and roast on medium heat for 7-9 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and slowly add boiled water while stirring continuously.
Cover and cook on low for 2 minutes.
Stir in remaining ghee and lemon/lime juice.
Garnish with cilantro and serve (optionally with coconut chutney).

recipes.name: Varan Bhaat
recipes.notes: Maharashtra. V / GF. Rice & Plain Dal.
steps: Wash the toor dal a few times, then soak in a bowl of lukewarm water for 1-2 hours.

Once soaked, place the dal in a pot with fresh water, along with the turmeric and asafoetida and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer until soft, about 1 hour. Mash until smooth, adding hot water to adjust the consistency as needed (it should be pourable like sambar).
While the dal is cooking, wash the rice. Soak it in a pot with 2 cups of water for 15-30 minutes.

Bring the rice to a boil in its soaking water over medium heat, uncovered. Once most of the surface water is absorbed, cover and reduce the heat to medium-low. Cook for 15 minutes (setting a timer may be helpful). Turn off the heat and let it sit for 5-10 minutes before serving.
Ghee can be added to the rice once it starts to boil.
Serve the rice topped with the dal along with a spoon of ghee and a quarter of lemon on the side.

recipes.name: Vegetable Pulav

ingredients.prep_notes: half a head medium, cut into medium florets

steps: Wash and soak the rice for 30 minutes, then drain.
Soak the saffron in 1 tablespoon warm water to let the flavor bloom, then add the coconut milk.
Grind or mash the chili paste ingredients together.
In a large pot, heat the oil. Add the cinnamon, bay leaves, cardamom and cloves, along with the onion. Saute until the onion is golden brown. Add the chili paste and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the pureed tomato, half the mint and half the cilantro, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the kasuri methi, the cauliflower, green peas, green beans and salt, and stir to combine.
Cover the pot and cook over medium heat until the vegetables are almost done, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the water and coconut milk (with saffron), along with the remaining cilantro and mint. Mix well to combine.

Add the drained rice and cook over medium heat until the water is absorbed. Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and cook for about 15 minutes. Check occasionally that the rice isn't sticking to the pan.
Switch off the heat and let the pulav sit for about 10 minutes before removing the lid.
Fluff with a spatula or fork, being careful to not break the rice grains.

recipes.name: Vermicelli Payasam
steps: Warm 1-2 tablespoons of the milk. Crush the saffron lightly between your fingers and add to the milk. Soak for about an hour.
Place the remaining milk in a pot and bring to a boil over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally to prevent scalding.
Meanwhile in a saucepan, heat the ghee over low heat and roast the cashews and raisins until they are golden brown and the raisins puff up, being careful not to burn them. Remove and set aside.
In the same saucepan, add the vermicelli and roast for 3-5 minutes until it turns golden brown. Add 1 cup water and cook until the vermicelli is tender.
Add the cooked vermicelli to the boiling milk and mix. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, for 10-15 minutes until the vermicelli softens and the payasam thickens to a creamy consistency.
Mix in the sugar and allow it to dissolve. Taste for sweetness and add more sugar if desired.
Boil the mixture over low heat until the payasam reaches the desired consistency. Then add the roasted cashews and raisins.
Switch off the heat, add the cardamom and soaked saffron milk, and mix well.
Payasam is served warm, but is also delicious cold.

recipes.name: Yellow Cucumber Pickle
steps: Wash the yellow cucumbers and wipe dry. Remove the seeds and cut into 1/2 inch pieces, skin included.
Toss them in a bowl with the red chili powder, salt, mustard powder, roasted fenugreek powder and turmeric, and mix well.
Add the oil and mix once again. Cover and let sit in a cool, dry spot for 12-24 hours to allow the flavors to meld.
Store in a clean, dry glass container in the refrigerator.

recipes.name: Yellow Moong Dal Masala Palak Khichdi
recipes.notes: North India. V / GF. Spiced Spinach Khichdi.

ingredients.prep_notes: or small bag of baby spinach, washed and chopped

steps: Wash the rice and moong dal.
Blend the ginger and green chilies together to make a coarse paste.

In a deep pot, heat the oil over medium heat. Once hot, lower the heat, add the cloves and cinnamon and allow them to sizzle. Add the cumin seeds, asafoetida, dried red chilies and turmeric. Saute for a few seconds before adding the chili paste.

Add the washed dal and rice and saute for 4-5 minutes. Pour in the water and cook uncovered over medium heat until the dal and rice are done and the consistency is thick like porridge, but not dry (add a little water if necessary).
Add the ground coriander, ground cumin, red chili powder and salt, and mix well.
Add the lemon juice and spinach. Cook until the spinach wilts slightly -- it should be bright green and not fully cooked. Switch off the heat. The remaining heat will cook the spinach.
Garnish with ghee.

recipes.name: Zucchini Sabzi with Green Pepper
steps: Quarter the zucchini across its length and chop into 1 cm thin sllices. Chop the green pepper and onion into 1 inch pieces
Heat mustard oil in the pot until it is smoking. Once smoking, reduce the heat. Add panch phoran and let it sizzle.
Add onions, curry leaves, turmeric, hing, and red chilly powder. Add green pepper and zucchini and saute on medium-high flame
Add salt to taste. At this stage zucchini will release water
Cook on medium high flame until the zucchini is ccooked and most of the water evaporates. Keep turning in the interim to prevent it from burning
Add garam masala and cilantro and give it a good mix. And you are done!

recipes.name: Zucchini Sabzi with tomato
steps: Quarter the zucchini across its length and chop into 1 cm thin sllices. Roughly chop the tomato into 1 inch pieces
Heat mustard oil in the pot until it is smoking. Once smoking, reduce the heat. Add panch phoran and let it sizzle. Add garlic, curry leaves, turmeric, hing, and red chilly powder
Add tomato and zucchini and saute on medium-high flame. Add salt to taste. At this stage zucchini will release water
Cook on medium high flame until the zucchini and tomato is cooked and most of the water evaporates. Keep turning in the interim to prevent it from burning
Add garam masala and cilantro and give it a good mix. And you are done!
